# The paths a branch push runs the merge queue's scope for (full, not
# light) when its change touches one: what a light run leaves out (the
# alpine-x86_64 leg, the regressions, the product suite, assemble and
# the checked shares) is where a change to these fails, and only in the
# queue, a pass and a requeue later. .github/scripts/branch-scope.sh
# reads it, one shell `case` pattern a line (a `*` takes `/` too, so
# `ci/*` is every file under ci/), the first word of each line; a line
# starting `!` takes back the paths it matches. A line's later words
# and a `#` comment are for the reader.
#
# build/workflows_test.tl holds this list to what ci.yml hashes into its
# caches (the entries below that say so), and every file named in full to
# exist.
#
# Docs and every test file not named here move nothing.
!*.md

# The CI driver, the pinned tools and what the legs run: the key of the
# driver's check hashes these (ci.yml's "find a passing CI driver check").
ci/*
bin/*
.github/workflows/ci.yml
.github/actions/*
.github/scripts/*
.github/seccomp/*

# The zig build's inputs: cache-names' `vendor` and `core` hashes.
build.zig
build.zig.zon
build/zig.tl
vendor/*
!vendor/tzdata/*
!vendor/cacert/*
!vendor/onecrl/*
!vendor/htmx/*
!vendor/htmx-ext-sse/*
!vendor/wpt-url/*
!vendor/html5lib-tokenizer/*
!vendor/wpt-html-parsing/*
patch/*
core/ares_config.h
core/curl_config.h
core/mbedtls_cosmic_config.h
core/xz_config/*
core/darwin-compat/*
core/*.c
core/*.h
core/*.zig
test/portable/*.c

# The harness: a change to a module it names moves this file
# (build/harness_epoch_test.tl), and a queue run whose change moves it
# runs every test (orchestration.tl's `harness_moved`).
build/harness_epoch.tl

# The artifact format, the launcher, boot and the vocabulary a test's
# `requires` is held to, which the pinned driver the regressions run may
# not know (a name newer than ci/cosmic-driver.pin fails ci/'s
# fixtures there, as `all_cores` did).
build/artifact.tl
build/embed.tl
build/boot.tl
build/reboot.tl
build/launcher.tl
build/paths.tl
build/host_names.tl
build/host_requires.tl
